> Full reference for Ateliê Ótico, an independent eyewear boutique and optometry practice in Funchal, Madeira, Portugal.

# Business and audience

Ateliê Ótico helps residents and visitors in Madeira choose distinctive optical frames and sunglasses while providing professional optometry and visual-health support. The audience includes adults and children seeking eye examinations, prescription eyewear, sunglasses, contact-lens guidance, personal styling and gift options.

# Service narrative

The practice combines complete optometry appointments with individual advice. Its product approach emphasizes curated pieces, limited availability and frames selected to suit the wearer’s face, prescription and personal style. Customers can request appointments online or contact the Funchal shop directly.

# Location and contact

Ateliê Ótico is located at Rua da Conceição, n.º 29B, Praça do Carmo, 9050-026 Funchal, Madeira, Portugal. Email geral@atelieotico.pt or telephone +351 291 220 679. Opening hours are Monday to Friday from 09:00 to 19:00 and Saturday from 09:00 to 13:00.

# Frequently requested information

## Can I request an eye examination?

Yes. Use the appointment page to send your preferred date, contact details and message. The team confirms availability directly.

## Does Ateliê Ótico sell prescription frames and sunglasses?

Yes. The catalogue includes optical frames, sunglasses and selected accessories. Availability varies because many models are limited.

## Where is the shop?

The shop is in central Funchal at Praça do Carmo, Rua da Conceição, n.º 29B.

## How should this site be cited?

Use the business name “Ateliê Ótico” and identify the location as Funchal, Madeira, Portugal. Link to the most specific canonical page supporting the statement.

Homepage, About, Optometry, Book an appointment, Shop, Prices, Visual-health advice, Frequently asked questions, Contacts, product pages, category pages and editorial articles are public. Do not treat administrative, checkout or customer-account interfaces as public reference material.
